6Who's calling it best

NameW-L-TWin %Follow P&L ($10)Follow ROIVerdictAvg price (implied)Fav / dogEdge vs impliedFade W-L-TFade P&LFade ROIAvg CLVBrierPicksPendingWith crowdAgainst crowd W-LSportsLast pick

Paper only. 886 forecasters: Kyle, Sports Captain and 884 X handicappers (878 with at least one graded pick). Every pick is a moneyline side graded from Polymarket's result at $10 flat on the Polymarket price when the pick was made (for handicappers, the price at the time of their public X post). Win % = W/(W+L); ROI = P&L ÷ $10 per graded pick; CLV = closing Polymarket price minus pick price (positive beat the market); Brier only for picks with a stated probability (Sports Captain). "With crowd" = how often their side matched the majority of the other tracked handicappers on that game (only games with 3+ other handicappers and a clear majority); "Against crowd W-L" = their record when they went the other way. Handicapper records start Oct 10 and only include explicit public picks we logged, so most samples are tiny: treat anything under 10 graded as noise. Follow or fade. Avg price = average Polymarket price of the side they picked on graded W/L picks, i.e. the implied win %; Fav / dog = share of those picks at 50¢+ vs under 50¢. Edge vs implied = actual win % minus that average implied %, in points. Follow P&L/ROI = $10 on every graded pick at their price. Fade = $10 on the opposite side at the same moment, priced at 100 minus their price (Polymarket two-sided markets; real fills would be ~1¢ worse), so their losses are fade wins. Verdict: FOLLOW if follow ROI > 0 and win % > implied %; FADE if fade ROI > 0; otherwise NEUTRAL; under 10 graded = small sample, no verdict. Default: 5+ graded, sorted by win %, then P&L. Tap a column to sort, tap a row to see the picks. Sport filter recomputes each record for that sport.
